name: Tome of Twilight
summary: At Krol'dok Stronghold, you are asked to recover the Tome of Twilight. Its contents may aid the fight against the cultists.

sections.title: A Hidden Record
sections.body: The stronghold’s secrets may hold useful knowledge about the cultists. You are asked to search Krol'dok Stronghold and recover the Tome of Twilight, so its information can be brought back.

faq.answer: You are asked to recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.
The tome may contain information useful in the fight against the cultists.

faq.q: Where is the Tome of Twilight?
faq.answer: The Tome of Twilight is to be recovered from Krol'dok Stronghold.
